business_scope.primary_industry_name: Wholesale Importation of Deep-Frozen Meat Carcasses and Pelagic Fish

meta_jurisdiction_context.legal_system_doctrine: Hybrid (English Common Law, statutory legislation, and customary land law)

Agreement between Samoa and Australia on the Exchange of Information on Tax Matters
Agreement between Samoa and New Zealand on the Exchange of Information on Tax Matters

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Money Laundering Prevention Act 2007 (as amended); Proceeds of Crime Act 2006; Anti-Terrorism Act 2012; International Companies Act 1987 (as amended); Companies Act 2001; Financial Intelligence Unit Act 2007; and applicable International Companies (Fees and Forms) Regulations require customer due diligence, beneficial ownership identification, and delegation of statutory AML/CFT duties to licensed registered agents in Samoa.
ubo_and_aml_profiling.ubo_disclosure_level: Government_Only_Access; confidential to the licensed registered agent; not publicly accessible; disclosed to the Registrar of International Companies and Samoa Financial Intelligence Unit on lawful demand; nominee arrangements are permissible only where the underlying beneficial owner is identified to the Government in accordance with the applicable anti-money laundering provisions.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Notarized Certified Copy of Biometric Passport of each Shareholder, Director and Ultimate Beneficial Owner
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notary Public in the jurisdiction of residence; English translation/certified transliteration if original is not in English
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille (Samoa is a Contracting State; consular legalization not required for other Contracting States)

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Incumbency or Register of Directors and Officers
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Licensed Registered Agent of the Samoa International Company in Apia
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille issued by the Samoa Ministry of Foreign Affairs and Trade after notarization by a Samoa notary

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Subscriber Consent and Notarized Signature Page for the Memorandum and Articles of Association
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notary Public in the country of origin of each subscriber
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille or, where the origin country is not a Hague Convention member, full consular legalization

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Consent to Act as Director and Consent to Act as Shareholder
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Individual director/shareholder or notarized legal representative; corporates provide extracted board resolution and certificate of good standing
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille; corporate public official certification accepted only with apostille

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Registered Agent Consent and Registered Office Confirmation
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Samoa apostille path via Registrar of International Companies authentication
Issuance is direct from the Samoan Registry; recipient-side legalization only if required by the foreign bank or counterparty

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory customer due diligence under the Money Laundering Prevention Act 2007; mandatory enhanced due diligence for politically exposed persons, including foreign PEPs, with senior management or board-level approval; mandatory screening of all identified directors, shareholders, beneficial owners, authorized signatories and counterparties against the United Nations Security Council Consolidated List, OFAC SDN List, UK HMT, EU consolidated sanctions list, Australia/ASTRA and DFAT sanctions and the Samoa FIU designated list; continuous re-screening is required at all stages of account opening and during each Swift/TT or revolving-letter-of-credit payment in the frozen beef and seafood import trade; trade-based money laundering red flag checks are applied to customs declarations, cold-chain invoices, bills of lading and LC documents.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Samoa International Companies Registry — Name Reservation and Search Desk (operated by the Registrar of International Companies within the Samoa Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Labour; online counterpart through the Ministry's digital company search portal)
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: Official languages are English and Samoan. A company name must be in Latin alphabet characters; Samoan words are permitted provided an English transliteration and translation are filed. The name must not imply any connection with the Government of Samoa or any public authority. The name must end with a permissible limited-liability suffix such as Limited, Ltd., Corporation, Incorporated or Public Limited Company. Non-English supporting documentation must be accompanied by a certified English translation.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: Name reservations are valid for 30 days from issuance and cannot be extended; upon expiration the applicant must submit a new reservation application with fresh fees. If the Registrar rejects a proposed name, the applicant or its licensed registered agent may, within 14 days of the notice of refusal, file a written appeal with the Registrar stating legal and factual grounds and proposing up to two alternative names. The Registrar shall reconsider the application administratively and issue a written decision. Within 21 days of that reconsideration decision, a further appeal may be lodged with the Minister responsible for Commerce, Industry and Labour. Filing fees are non-refundable and no hearing is granted; the Minister's written order is final and binding in the name-clearance process.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: A virtual office is permissible for a non-resident Samoa International Company only to the extent that a licensed registered agent in Apia maintains the statutory registered office and accepts service of process. No physical employees or premises are required for a pure holding/trading shell. However, if the entity becomes the actual importer of record for frozen beef or seafood under Samoa customs, biosecurity and fisheries-control legislation, the importer-of-record function will require a physical local business address and, where applicable, customs/quarantine-registered cold-chain premises; a purely virtual office cannot satisfy that operational licensing condition.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Low: approximately 5% annual probability for a non-resident, tax-exempt International Company with no local operating presence. Increased to 20–35% if the company applies for Samoa import permits, customs declarations, biosecurity clearance or regulated cold-chain food import licences, because the competent authority may perform unannounced site inspections of registered importer premises and verifying the commercial substance of the food import operation.

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: International Companies Act 1987 (as amended by the International Companies Amendment Act 2008), ss. 5, 7, 9, 17, 25, 82–92; Business Licence Act 1998
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Samoa International Finance Authority (SIFA) — International Companies Registry, Apia
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Memorandum and Articles of Association together with Certificate of Incorporation (Statutory Form IA-1)
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum paid-up capital. A single ordinary share of par value USD 1 is conventionally subscribed; capital may be denominated in any freely convertible currency. No escrow deposit or bank capital verification requirement applies to an International Company.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED: (1) that the subscriber to this Company hereby subscribes to and is allotted the number of ordinary shares set out in the share subscription sheet, and the stated consideration is accepted as fully paid. (2) that the registered office of the Company shall be at the office of the licensed registered agent, Apia. (3) that [Director 1] and [Director 2] are appointed first directors, and [Secretary] is appointed secretary. (4) that the directors are authorized to open bank accounts and proceed with all statutory licensing applications. (5) that the minutes of this meeting be entered in the statutory minute book.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Samoa International Finance Authority (SIFA) — International Companies Registry, Apia
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit a name reservation application through a licensed international company registered agent. The proposed name must end with 'Limited' or 'Ltd' and must not be identical or deceptively similar to any existing registered name. SIFA issues a written name availability confirmation upon pre-clearance review.
required_dossiers: Copy of subscriber's passport or identity document
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the name is refused, the agent may immediately submit a fresh reservation with up to three alternative names. A written appeal against refusal may be lodged with the SIFA Registrar within 14 days pursuant to section 17 of the International Companies Act 1987.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Execution and Lodgement of Memorandum and Articles of Association
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: SIFA — International Companies Registry (acting through licensed registered agent)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Execute the Memorandum and Articles of Association before a notary public. The registered agent physically or electronically lodges the notarized instrument, together with statutory declarations and consents, to the SIFA Companies Registry. SIFA logs the application, assigns a company file number, and initiates substantive compliance review.
required_dossiers: Notarized Memorandum and Articles of Association (three originals)
Consent to act of each first director and the secretary
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Where SIFA raises a query or notes a defect, the registered agent files an amended instrument reflecting the required correction. The applicant retains priority if the corrected filing is resubmitted within 14 days; no re-payment of the base fee is required for non-substantive amendments.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Payment of Statutory Fees and Issuance of Certificate of Incorporation
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: SIFA Finance Unit and Ministry of Finance, Apia
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Pay the prescribed incorporation fee of USD 100 plus applicable registered agent fee by bank transfer to the SIFA Companies Registry account, quoting the assigned file number. Upon reconciliation, SIFA issues the Certificate of Incorporation under seal, stating the company number and date of incorporation. The certificate is conclusive evidence that the International Company has separate legal personality.
required_dossiers: Bank transfer or SWIFT confirmation of fee payment
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If payment is not reconciled within five business days, the agent presents the SWIFT record to the SIFA Finance Unit for matching. A lost or erroneously worded certificate may be re-issued upon submission of a statutory declaration and a lost-certificate indemnity.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Post-Incorporation Governance and Statutory Register Maintenance
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Licensed registered office of the Company, Apia; SIFA records
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Convene the first board meeting to adopt the registered office as stated on the Certificate of Incorporation, subscribe and allot the initial ordinary shares, and appoint the first directors and secretary. Record the proceedings in the statutory minute book and prepare the registers of members, directors, secretaries and charges for safekeeping at the registered office in accordance with sections 82 to 92 of the International Companies Act 1987.
required_dossiers: First Board Meeting Minutes incorporating the pro-forma resolution
Register of members, directors and secretary
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: In the event of an administrative penalty for a late filing or an outdated registered address, the company may file a Notice of Change with SIFA and pay the applicable late filing fee. The Registrar will accept a written corrective submission; enforcement action may be challenged by formal written representation to the Registrar.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Business Licence and Food-Import Trade Authorization
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Labour (MCIL) — One-Stop Shop, Apia
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Apply for the Business Licence under the Business Licence Act 1998, presenting the Certificate of Incorporation, company constituent documents, manager identification, registered address and lease or ownership proof of the storage premises. The scope of business is stated as 'Wholesale importation and distribution of deep-frozen meat carcasses and pelagic fish'. Thereafter obtain a customs trader code, a food import declaration clearance from the Ministry of Health Nutrition Centre, and a biosecurity import permit from the Ministry of Agriculture and Fisheries for shipments of animal-derived products.
required_dossiers: Memorandum and Articles of Association and director identification
Lease agreement or title deed for the frozen-storage premises
Food import declaration and biosecurity permit application
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the licence is queried or refused, the applicant may amend and resubmit the scope description within 14 days. A formal appeal lies to the MCIL Licensing Committee within 30 days of refusal. Health-related objections are cured by satisfying sanitation inspection findings and re-inspecting the cold storage facility.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Labour (MCIL) — Licensing and Trade Division, Apia
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Business Licence (Wholesale/Import Trader — Frozen Meat and Seafood) and Food Import Clearance under the Food and Drugs Act 1967 and the Food Regulations 1983

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Planning and Urban Management Agency (PUMA), Ministry of Natural Resources and Environment (MNRE), Apia
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Category 2 — Registration (Low-Impact) for reuse of existing cold-storage premises; Development Consent required for any new refrigerated warehouse construction; Full EIA Report only for industrial-scale frozen storage facilities exceeding PUMA floor-area thresholds.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Defrost and cleaning wastewater must meet Samoa Water Authority (SWA) trade waste discharge limits; refrigerant systems must comply with the Ozone Depleting Substances Regulations 2001; product handling must satisfy HACCP/Codex temperature-control standards; no open VOC emissions are permitted; solid waste and offal disposal must follow MNRE waste management criteria.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire Safety Certificate issued by the Samoa Fire and Emergency Services Authority (SFESA) for the premises; structural load clearance for refrigeration plant installation issued by MCIL or a licensed engineer; workplace occupational safety clearance under the Labour and Employment Relations Act 2013; plus biosecurity and pest-control certification for the frozen storage environment.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Ministry of Revenue of Samoa, Taxpayer Services Division, Apia, Samoa; online and taxpayer portal at https://www.revenue.gov.ws, with import/customs declarations processed through the ASYCUDA World electronic single window under Samoa Customs Service.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: A foreign-owned Samoa International Company first files the Business/Taxpayer Registration Application (Form BTR-01) with the Ministry of Revenue together with the certificate of incorporation, the current Certificate of Exemption issued under the International Companies Act 2012, the memorandum and articles, certificate of registered office in Samoa, passport copies of directors/beneficial owners, and a statement of anticipated import/export turnover. The Ministry issues a Taxpayer Identification Number (TIN) and, where the entity conducts import activities, a VAGST registration number; the same TIN is used as the Customs client identifier in ASYCUDA World. Processing is ordinarily completed within five to ten business days.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: No US-style check-the-box election exists. A Samoa International Company may elect to be treated as an International Company under the International Companies Act 2012, thereby securing exemption from Samoan income tax on non-Samoa-source income, subject to its Certificate of Exemption. For indirect tax purposes, the entity may voluntarily elect VAGST registration before reaching the statutory threshold, but may not elect to be treated as a transparent entity; hybrid mismatch elections are unavailable in Samoa.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: Value Added Goods and Services Tax (VAGST) administered by the Samoa Ministry of Revenue under the Value Added Goods and Services Tax Act 2003, as amended.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: WST 100,000 of annual taxable supplies; registration is compulsory from the date the threshold is reached or exceeded, and applies to importers of goods for business use where imports exceed the threshold in the relevant twelve-month period.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: Samoa does not mandate real-time fiscal e-invoicing or digital stamping of invoices. However, all import and export declarations, customs value calculations, payment of VAGST and duty, and supporting document uploads must be lodged electronically through the ASYCUDA World system. VAGST-registered persons must issue compliant VAGST invoices and retain electronic records, with clearance of imports conditional on the ASYCUDA assessment and payment of applicable VAGST at importation.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: VAGST is zero-rated on export supplies of goods physically shipped out of Samoa, on services supplied to non-residents that are wholly consumed outside Samoa, and on international carriage of goods and passengers. A zero-rating claim requires the exporter to hold sufficient documentary evidence that the goods left Samoa or the services were supplied and consumed offshore, including transport evidence, customs clearance, and proof of foreign currency payment from a non-resident buyer.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration processed and authenticated through ASYCUDA World evidencing actual exportation from Samoa
Bill of Lading, Air Waybill, or equivalent ocean/air cargo transport document showing physical movement of frozen beef or seafood out of Samoan territory
Commercially certified export invoice and packing list describing the goods, quantity, and net weight, cross-referenced to the customs export declaration
Inward Remittance Certificate issued by a licensed Samoan commercial bank evidencing receipt of the foreign currency sale proceeds from the non-resident buyer
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: Export zero-rating claims are closely scrutinized by the Ministry of Revenue and Samoa Customs. Where goods are not in fact exported, where proceeds are not repatriated within the 180-day deadline, or where documentation is fabricated, the full 15% VAGST is immediately assessed, any refund is clawed back with interest, and penalties of up to 150% of the tax shortfall may be imposed under the Tax Administration Act 2012. Fraudulent claims may result in criminal prosecution and forfeiture of goods.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Central Bank of Samoa (CBS), Exchange Control and Money Laundering Prevention Authority, Apia, Samoa; statutory mandate under the Exchange Control Act 1978 and the Money Laundering Prevention Act 2018.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: The Samoa Tala (WST) has no deep offshore deliverable market and remains subject to centralised exchange control. Current-account payments for genuine imports are generally permitted through an Authorized Dealer once commercial documentation is verified. Capital-account inflows into a Samoa International Company (IC) are treated as external capital and may be credited to a foreign-currency non-resident account without mandatory WST conversion; however, any subsequent conversion of WST into foreign currency, or remittance of local WST proceeds attributable to domestic activities, requires CBS Authorized Dealer approval. Profit remittance hurdles are moderate: the IC’s tax-exempt status must be evidenced by its Certificate of Incorporation/exemption letter and a board resolution declaring that no local Samoan business was conducted, otherwise the remittance may be re-characterised as local income or a prohibited IC activity.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: For physical exports from Samoa, the exporter must repatriate export proceeds through an Authorized Dealer within 30 days of receipt and convert 100% of the proceeds into WST unless the CBS grants a foreign-currency retention authorisation. For the WS_IC offshore trading platform, no customs export filing occurs in Samoa when the frozen beef and seafood shipments move directly from a non-Samoan seller to a non-Samoan buyer; incoming trade proceeds may remain in a designated USD non-resident account without mandatory surrender, provided the IC can evidence that the goods and underlying trade transaction did not pass through the Samoan customs territory.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: USD non-resident operating account; Revolving Import Letter of Credit facility

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.bank_name: Bank of South Pacific (BSP) Samoa Limited
tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: USD/WST operating account; Documentary Sight and Term Import LC; trade settlement escrow
WST operational account; term deposit and margin account for CBS-approved FX forwards

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Low and unsuitable as a primary clearing rail. Samoa has no digital EMI licensing regime, and CBS does not recognise offshore electronic money institutions as Authorized Dealers. An offshore fintech EMI cannot hold WST, issue Samoa-based import letters of credit, or discharge exchange-control reporting obligations. It may be used only as an ancillary USD collection mechanism for non-Samoan trade flows, subject to full customer due diligence and mirror-KYC; however, correspondent de-risking and the absence of regulatory supervision in Samoa make it unacceptable for capital escrow or trade settlement.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: CBS-supervised banks generally require at least one natural-person director, senior officer, or the IC’s licensed registered agent to attend an in-person onboarding interview at a Samoa branch. Remote video onboarding is technically contemplated but is normally not sufficient on its own; banks require certified passport copies, notarised corporate resolutions, and a registered-agent confirmatory letter. In practice, a Samoa-licensed registered agent may appear locally on behalf of the director, but the beneficial owner must still complete a documented video/telephone interview with the bank’s compliance officer before approval.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: International Company with no physical presence, no financial statements, and possible bearer-share exposure
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Certificate of Incorporation; certified copy of Memorandum and Articles; certificate of good standing; current register of directors and members; registered agent’s confirmatory declaration that no bearer shares exist; beneficial ownership declaration in CBS-compliant form; certified passport and proof of residential address for each 10%+ beneficial owner.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: High-value, high-frequency imports of frozen meat and seafood with multi-jurisdictional suppliers and complex invoices
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Executed master supply agreement; commercial invoices aligned with packing lists and bills of lading; HS 0202 and 0303 classifications; certificate of origin; veterinary/health certificates from exporting country; cold-chain temperature logs; customs/quarantine permits if goods transit or enter Samoa; independent cargo survey report; supplier KYC file.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Inbound capital injection funded by third-party wiring or shareholder loans without clear source of funds
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Board resolution authorising the capital injection; executed subscription or shareholder loan agreement; source-of-wealth statement; remitting entity’s and personal account bank statements; tax identification number; foreign tax residence certificate; evidence that remitting bank is not a shell or unlicensed entity; CBS external-transaction declaration.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Trade-based money-laundering indicators: invoice mismatches, dual invoicing, transshipment through high-risk free zones, or over/under-pricing
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Harmonised trade records across LC, invoice, packing list, bill of lading, and customs declaration; Incoterms 2020 statement; third-party surveyor/weight certificate; freight-forwarder audit trail; contract of carriage with full route; economic substance memorandum; bank statement reconciling purchase price, freight, insurance, and commission to final invoice value.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Approved routing is a SWIFT MT103 from the shareholder’s bank in the shareholder’s jurisdiction to ANZ Bank Samoa Limited or BSP Samoa Limited for credit to the WS_IC USD non-resident account. Field 70 must clearly contain the composite reference 'CAP WS_IC FROZEN-BEEF-SEAFOOD-IMPORT' and use a CBS-recognised external purpose code such as 'equity participation / foreign direct investment'. The remitting bank shall pre-advise the Samoa receiving bank with the Certificate of Incorporation, board resolution approving the capital contribution, source-of-funds evidence, and a copy of the CBS authorised-dealer foreign-exchange declaration. Funds must be received in USD or AUD/NZD; crypto, third-party pass-through, or unregulated marketplace transfers are not compliant. If WST liquidity is later needed, conversion is executed at the Authorized Dealer’s onshore rate and only for bona fide local operating expenses, not for outward profit remittance without CBS approval.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: For open-account import settlements, the WS_IC instructs the Samoa bank to issue a SWIFT MT103 with Field 70 containing the invoice number, product tariff line, supplier name, and purpose code 'import payment for goods'. The Samoa bank must hold the proforma invoice, underlying signed contract, shipping document, and Samoa customs import declaration where goods cross Samoan customs. For documentary trade, the bank opens an irrevocable revolving Letter of Credit via SWIFT MT700 in favour of the global supplier; settlement under the LC is effected by MT103/MT202 against compliant presentation of bill of lading, commercial invoice, packing list, health certificates, and any required certificate of origin. Where the frozen beef and seafood are pure cross-border flows not landing in Samoa, payments can be made directly from the WS_IC USD account using the same documentary package and an 'offshore transit trade' purpose code; the Samoan bank records the transaction for CBS statistical reporting but no local import duty filing arises.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Deliverable WST/USD FX forward from a CBS Authorized Dealer, tenor up to 12 months, supported by a genuine underlying import settlement or capital transaction.
Non-deliverable WST/USD FX forward (NDF) with a licensed offshore bank, subject to CBS exchange-control approval, because WST is not fully deliverable outside Samoa.

Cross-currency swap (WST/USD) for conversion of an approved external loan or trade facility, subject to CBS case-by-case approval and a maximum tenor aligned to the underlying real commercial exposure.

FX options are not permitted as a standalone speculative instrument; they may be considered only where the CBS has issued an express hedging licence and the IC demonstrates no residual open position beyond the trade volume.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Return and Renewal Confirmation under the International Companies Act 2012
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Samoa International Finance Authority – Registrar of International Companies
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: On or before each incorporation anniversary date; a 30-calendar-day grace period is permitted by the Registrar
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late payment penalty of 10% of the annual fee; if the annual fee remains unpaid for 3 months after the anniversary date, the Registrar may issue a 60-day strike-off notice; failure to remedy results in administrative dissolution and removal from the register.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Registered Office and Register Maintenance Confirmation (no public filing)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Samoa International Finance Authority – Registrar of International Companies via licensed registered agent
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 30 calendar days after each incorporation anniversary
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: No dedicated filing fee; failure to maintain the statutory registers in Samoa incurs fines up to WST 1,000 for the company and each officer in default; chronic non-maintenance may be treated as a ground for administrative strike-off.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Import / Wholesale Dealer Licence Renewal for Frozen Meat and Seafood
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Samoa Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Labour and Samoa Customs
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Renew by 31 December each year or 60 days before licence expiry, whichever is earlier
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Expired or non-renewed licence suspends customs clearance and wholesale import privileges; continued trading without a valid licence subjects the importer to monetary penalties and suspension of import permits; does not trigger company strike-off.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: No mandatory statutory audit for Samoa International Companies under the International Companies Act 2012. An audit becomes compulsory only when requisitioned by shareholders holding at least 10% of voting power, where the company has listed or public securities, or where the company is a licensed financial institution subsidiary required by SIFA and the Central Bank of Samoa.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: No prescribed local GAAP; the company must maintain records sufficient to explain transactions and enable financial position to be ascertained with reasonable accuracy. IFRS is voluntarily acceptable and considered compliant for any exemption filing under Samoa tax law.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: Samoa does not require a publicly filed annual UBO return. The registered agent must verify beneficial owners at onboarding and update the internal UBO database on any share transfer. Share transfers must be recorded in the register of members within 14 days of approval; an updated director and member register confirmation is maintained by the registered agent. SIFA may issue an AML/UBO information request requiring confirmation within 21 days.

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: Not mandatory; voluntary audit USD 2,500 - USD 5,000 per engagement

corporate_income_tax_regime.statutory_headline_rate: 0% for a Samoa International Company under the International Companies Act 1987 (as amended); the onshore resident corporate income tax headline rate is 27% and is not applicable to an exempt International Company.
corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: Statutory exemption from Samoa income tax on worldwide business profits, capital gains, interest, royalties, dividends, and other distributions. No tax holiday application is required; the exemption attaches to the International Company class. Annual government fees are limited to registry fees and the licensed agent’s service fee. Loss relief is not relevant because no assessable income arises.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: No corporate income tax return is required for an exempt International Company. Administrative filing is limited to the Annual Return of an International Company lodged with the Samoa International Financial Authority (SIFA) through the licensed registered agent’s electronic portal.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: The Annual Return is due within the period prescribed under the International Companies Act 1987, normally aligned with the anniversary of incorporation or the calendar year for licensed companies. No Ministry for Revenue income tax return due date applies to the exempt entity.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Physical Samoa-registered office address maintained by the licensed registered agent.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: The non-resident company must enter the Samoa registered-office address provided by its licensed agent; a foreign business address may be stated only as correspondence address.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Name, licence number, and contact details of the Samoa-licensed registered agent.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-resident shareholders cannot act as the registered agent; the entry must identify the locally licensed agent appointed.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Full legal names, residential addresses, and identification particulars of all directors and the company secretary.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-resident directors are permitted. Provide certified passport copies, proof of residential address, and any regulatory clearance required by the agent’s AML/KYC procedures.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Box 4 - Share Register and Beneficial Ownership
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Registered shareholder details and ultimate beneficial owner disclosure required under Samoa’s AML/CFT framework.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-resident beneficial owners must submit the same information as resident owners; bearer shares, if permitted, must be immobilised with the agent or otherwise made transparent.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing of the Annual Return or non-payment of the annual licence fee exposes the International Company to late fee surcharges and possible strike-off by the Registrar. Continued default may result in dissolution of the company and disqualification of its directors. Where a taxable return should exist, the Tax Administration Act imposes separate late-filing penalties and interest, but such obligations do not arise for the exempt International Company.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: 0% on any dividend or distribution made by a Samoa International Company to its non-resident shareholders.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: Not required for Samoa-source payments because the International Company exemption removes any domestic withholding tax. If a dividend flows from a foreign subsidiary to the Samoa International Company and the relevant Double Taxation Agreement allocates taxing rights to Samoa or to the source state, the company must obtain a Samoa Tax Residence Certificate or tax exemption certificate from the Samoa Ministry for Revenue. The certificate is then submitted to the foreign payer or foreign revenue authority in support of reduced withholding tax or refund proceedings.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Statutory rate: 0% for royalties and interest paid by a Samoa International Company. Treaty rate: generally 0% under the domestic exemption; where a specific DTA or Tax Information Exchange Agreement applies, the Samoa tax exemption certificate and Tax Residence Certificate are used to evidence beneficial ownership before the foreign withholding authority.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: No Samoa Tala (WST) filing threshold triggers mandatory Local File or Master File for an exempt International Company. Samoa tax law does not impose a substantive transfer-pricing documentation regime on International Companies. Nevertheless, for intercompany purchases of frozen beef and seafood through the cold-chain trading model, a prudent taxpayer should prepare OECD-aligned transfer pricing evidence if any entity in the chain has taxable operations in another jurisdiction.
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: Samoa has not enacted an Economic Substance Regulations regime equivalent to BVI or Cayman. A Samoa International Company is not required to file an economic substance report solely because it carries on offshore trading. It must, however, maintain a registered office and licensed registered agent in Samoa and must not carry on prescribed domestic business activities in Samoa. For banking and AML counterparty purposes, substance is demonstrated by board minutes, contracts, purchase orders, bills of lading, and the actual commercial activity of importing frozen meat and seafood through the Samoa entity.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Tax Evasion and Fraudulent Tax Avoidance
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Deliberately misrepresenting an International Company as a resident company, manufacturing losses, filing false invoices for frozen beef or seafood imports, or using the Samoa entity to conceal taxable profits of a connected onshore trader.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Under Samoa’s Tax Administration Act and Income Tax Act, the offending entity and principals may be liable for the full underpaid tax, penalty of up to 200% of the tax shortfall, monetary fines, and imprisonment for tax evasion offences.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors who knowingly participate in false filings or who allow the International Company to be used as a sham may be personally and jointly liable for unpaid taxes and penalties. The court may issue travel bans, asset freezing orders, and custodial sentences for fraud-related tax evasion.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Shell Company and False Substance Representation
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Operating without a bona fide registered agent, failing to file the annual return, failing to pay annual registry fees, or holding a shell structure solely to deceive banks, customs authorities, or counterparties as to ownership and control.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: The Registrar may strike off the International Company, dissolve the registration, and impose monetary penalties. Continued non-compliance may also prohibit the directors from being appointed in any Samoa-registered company.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: A director who allows the company to trade while insolvent or after strike-off proceedings may be personally liable for debts incurred. Civil restitution and director disqualification orders are available against those who abuse the corporate form.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Anti-Money Laundering and Counter-Financing of Terrorism Breach
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Conducting high-value frozen meat and seafood import payment settlements through shell structures without performing beneficial-ownership due diligence, source-of-funds verification, or suspicious-transaction reporting, especially where revolving letters of credit and Swift TT payment rails are used.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Non-compliance with Samoa’s AML/CFT statutory obligations exposes the International Company and its registered agent to substantial fines, licence suspension, mandatory remedial orders, and criminal prosecution in egregious cases.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors and senior officers face criminal liability for money laundering, financing of terrorism, or AML compliance failures. Penalties include imprisonment, confiscation of proceeds, travel bans, and personal financial liability for laundering tainted funds.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Misrepresentation to Customs and Regulatory Authorities
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Under-declaring import values, misdescribing frozen beef or seafood consignments, using falsified health certificates, or operating without the required statutory import licensing for ISIC 4632 wholesale deep-frozen meat and fish importation.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Customs laws and the Ministry of Agriculture and Fisheries enforce seizure of the consignment, customs penalties, monetary fines, suspension or revocation of the import licence, and criminal prosecution for fraudulent importation.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors who sign false declarations or who direct unlawful importation may be held personally liable for customs penalties, restitution to the state, and imprisonment. Corporate veil-piercing is available where the International Company is used as a vehicle for deliberate regulatory evasion.
